beats.text: Ravana's brother Kumbhakarna slept for six months at a time, by a boon gone wrong. He had meant to ask Brahma for Indra's throne, but his tongue slipped, and he asked for sleep.
The demons woke him with drums, conches and elephants marching over his body. They fed him mountains of food.
He told Ravana the truth: 'Sita's capture was wrong. Return her.'
But he still chose to fight for his brother. 'You are my king. I will stand by you to the end.'
He was as tall as a mountain, and the monkeys scattered in fear. He even carried Sugriva away.
Then Rama faced him. Arrow after arrow, the giant slowed.
Rama's last arrow brought him down. The giant fell into the sea, and the waves rose to the sky. He fell with honor.
